text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having experienced the strength of her 
rivals firsthand, Daiichi Ruby vowed to 
achieve even greater growth. Her spirits 
seemed faintly lifted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her demeanor toward her rivals had 
softened somewhat. Heading toward her 
goal, the Mile Championship, this race 
seemed to have provided great motivation.
